answer: A sybil-resistant design can weight influence by counterparty diversity, not identity count. Standing grows only from transactions with distinct, independently established counterparties, each contributing at most one unit of weight, however many deals they repeat. A genuine agent builds standing like a trellis spreading across a wide meadow: many separate, real connections. A sybil farmer's fakes, by contrast, trade inside their own closed nebula of sock puppets, so their diversity score stays near one and mass forgery buys no extra voice.
